items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: he had people like Bobby Stark Stocks. Oh, no greater trumpet player ever lived than Bobby.

ctx.x: How had he been able to get such great bands together and keep them together, if that was the way he was (inaudible).

Well being such a musician he was, and now, meeting the guys, and getting the guys, somebody sent me. He didn't ask me. Somebody said well Fletcher needs a trumpet player. And he said go over there and tell him I sent you. Or just go there. One of those things. I happened to walk in. I was glad, and Fletcher was glad. Now whether -- he had people like Bobby Stark Stocks. Oh, no greater trumpet player ever lived than Bobby.
And that's a man who has very little been mentioned, one of the most underrated trumpet players I think in the country. Bobby Stark Stocks (sic) was a heck of a trumpet player.
